checks.gpu_guide: Localized decision content and existing-route links sit outside the purchase form. Blog guides require published indexed metadata and a real translation. No price, stock, selected plan, CSRF, form action, input names, script or font changes.

checks.author_history: Existing BlogRepository eager-author loading and attribution are unchanged; these diffs rewrite no editorial author/history fields. The original task base remains an ancestor of the fast-forwarded base, preserving unrelated financial history.
checks.test_quality: Dedicated coverage checks all3 locales, eligibility transition/header invariance, translated-vs-draft guide links, purchase-form/plan-state preservation, exact Offer serialization, empty noindex and nonpositive-price schema exclusion.

validation.parent_combined_tests: Parent reports48 tests/1471 assertions passed; not rerun by this reviewer.
